# LIOP — Logic-Injection-on-Origin Protocol

> LIOP is a high-performance, Zero-Trust binary transport mesh for AI Agent communication. Instead of pulling gigabytes of raw data to a central AI node, LIOP injects sandboxed WebAssembly (WASM) logic directly into data sources, reducing network bandwidth and token consumption by orders of magnitude. Results are returned with ZK-Receipts (HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic proofs) guaranteeing computational integrity. The TypeScript SDK (@nekzus/liop on NPM) provides a drop-in MCP-compatible gateway with Post-Quantum Cryptography (ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65), a 6-layer security pipeline, and a Differential Privacy engine compliant with NIST SP 800-226.

LIOP complements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) through a Hybrid Gateway that bridges both standards transparently. The SDK supports dual-era MCP compatibility (2026-07-28 stateless and 2025-11-25 legacy).

## TypeScript SDK
- [SDK Overview](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/overview): Feature matrix and public API
- [Server API](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/server): LiopServer, tool registration, Zod schemas
- [Client API](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/client): LiopClient, P2P mesh discovery, DHT routing
- [Hybrid Gateway](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/gateway): MCP bridge, HTTP adapter, Kubernetes probes
- [Token Economy](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/economy): BPE o200k_base inlined estimator, OpenTelemetry
- [Security](https://nekzus-32.mintlify.app/typescript-sdk/security): 6-layer shield, PQC sessions, PII detection, mTLS
